nodes.label: Save the general settings
nodes.detail: The Save button on Settings > General runs saveGeneral(), which stores the timezone in localStorage and then calls saveSettings()

nodes.label: Save the settings
nodes.detail: Once validateSettings() passes it emits setSettings with currentPassword and, on success, runs loadSettings() again

nodes.label: Load the settings
nodes.detail: Emits getSettings, applies the data from the response to this.settings and fills in the defaults

nodes.label: Save the proxy
nodes.detail: The ProxyDialog form submit emits addProxy with the proxy data and the id

nodes.label: Save the Docker host
nodes.detail: The Save button in DockerHostDialog emits addDockerHost with the dockerHost data and the id

nodes.label: Test the Docker host connection
nodes.detail: The Test button in DockerHostDialog emits testDockerHost and shows the answer in a toast

nodes.label: Save the remote browser
nodes.detail: The RemoteBrowserDialog form submit emits addRemoteBrowser with the remoteBrowser data and the id

nodes.label: Get the DB size
nodes.detail: On mount, or after a successful shrink, it emits getDatabaseSize and updates databaseSize

nodes.label: Shrink the DB
nodes.detail: The Shrink Database button emits shrinkDatabase and, on success, runs loadDatabaseSize() again

nodes.label: Clear all statistics
nodes.detail: The Clear all statistics button, then the Confirm dialog, calls $root.clearStatistics() and reloads the whole screen on success

nodes.label: Clear the event history
nodes.detail: Clear Data > Events on the monitor details screen, then the Confirm dialog, calls $root.clearEvents(monitorID)

nodes.label: Clear the heartbeats
nodes.detail: Clear Data > Heartbeats on the monitor details screen, then the Confirm dialog, calls $root.clearHeartbeats(monitorID)

nodes.label: Get the socket instance
nodes.detail: A general accessor returning the connected socket.io client instance. Many screens emit directly through it

nodes.label: Emit clear events
nodes.detail: A wrapper that emits clearEvents with the monitorID and a callback

nodes.label: Emit clear heartbeats
nodes.detail: A wrapper that emits clearHeartbeats with the monitorID and a callback

nodes.label: Emit clear all statistics
nodes.detail: A wrapper that emits clearStatistics with a callback

nodes.label: Accept the connection and register the events
nodes.detail: Called when the socket.io connection is established; every socket.on handler is registered inside it

nodes.label: Get the settings
nodes.detail: getSettings received. After checkLogin it calls getSettings("general"), fills in serverTimezone and returns

nodes.label: Save the settings
nodes.detail: setSettings received. It validates a disableAuth change, saves the settings, then applies the timezone, Chrome and nscd changes

nodes.label: Clear events
nodes.detail: clearEvents received. After checkLogin it UPDATEs heartbeat.msg/important directly for the given monitor_id

nodes.label: Clear heartbeats
nodes.detail: clearHeartbeats received. After checkLogin it calls UptimeCalculator.clearStatistics(monitorID) and restarts the monitor if it is active

nodes.label: Clear statistics (everything)
nodes.detail: clearStatistics received. After checkLogin it calls UptimeCalculator.clearAllStatistics() and restarts every active monitor

nodes.label: Add a proxy
nodes.detail: addProxy received. After checkLogin it calls Proxy.save, re-sends the list, and also calls reloadProxy when applyExisting is set

nodes.label: Add a Docker host
nodes.detail: addDockerHost received. After checkLogin it calls DockerHost.save and re-sends the list

nodes.label: Test a Docker host
nodes.detail: testDockerHost received. After checkLogin it calls DockerHost.testDockerHost and returns the container count (no DB change)

nodes.label: Add a remote browser
nodes.detail: addRemoteBrowser received. After checkLogin it calls RemoteBrowser.save and re-sends the list

nodes.label: Get the DB size
nodes.detail: getDatabaseSize received. After checkLogin it returns the result of Database.getSize()

nodes.label: Shrink the DB
nodes.detail: shrinkDatabase received. After checkLogin it calls Database.shrink()

nodes.label: Check login
nodes.detail: A synchronous check that just throws when socket.userID is missing. The shared entry guard for every handler

nodes.label: Re-check the password
nodes.detail: Verifies that currentPassword is a string and that it matches the user's current password

nodes.label: Get the settings (delegating)
nodes.detail: A helper in util-server.js. A thin wrapper that delegates straight to Settings.getSettings(type)

nodes.label: Save the settings (delegating)
nodes.detail: A helper in util-server.js. A thin wrapper that delegates straight to Settings.setSettings(type, data)

nodes.label: Get the settings (implementation)
nodes.detail: SELECTs every key/value of the given type from the setting table, JSON.parses them and returns an object

nodes.label: Save the settings in bulk (implementation)
nodes.detail: For each key in data it findOne/dispenses the bean of the matching type, JSON-stringifies the value, R.stores it and drops the cache

nodes.label: Save the proxy
nodes.detail: Validate the protocol, clear the existing default when default is set, put the values on the bean and R.store it; with applyExisting it is applied to every monitor

nodes.label: Apply to every monitor
nodes.detail: A private function called from inside save(). It UPDATEs proxy_id on every monitor of that user to the new ID

nodes.label: Reload the monitor list
nodes.detail: Called from the socket handler after a save. It refetches monitor.id and proxy_id and applies them to the in-memory monitorList (no DB write)

nodes.label: Save the Docker host
nodes.detail: Finds the existing bean by id + user_id or dispenses a new one, sets name/dockerDaemon/dockerType and R.stores it

nodes.label: Test the Docker connection
nodes.detail: Requests /containers/json?all=true from the Docker daemon over a socket or TCP and returns the container count. It changes nothing in the DB

nodes.label: Save the remote browser
nodes.detail: Finds the existing bean by id + user_id or dispenses a new one, sets name/url and R.stores it

nodes.label: Get the DB size
nodes.detail: Only under SQLite: returns the size of the kuma.db file via fs.stat. Otherwise it returns 0

nodes.label: Shrink the DB (VACUUM)
nodes.detail: Only under SQLite: runs R.exec("VACUUM") to compact the file. Otherwise it does nothing

nodes.label: Clear one monitor's statistics
nodes.detail: DELETEs all heartbeat / stat_minutely / stat_hourly / stat_daily rows for the given monitor_id and discards the in-memory Calculator

nodes.label: Clear every monitor's statistics
nodes.detail: DELETEs heartbeat / stat_minutely / stat_hourly / stat_daily for every monitor and discards every in-memory Calculator

nodes.label: Restart the monitor
nodes.detail: After clearing the statistics, a monitor that is active is stopped and started again to reset the UptimeCalculator state

nodes.label: setting table
nodes.detail: A general settings table in key/value/type form

nodes.label: proxy table
nodes.detail: Holds the proxy settings (protocol / host / port / credentials / active / default)

nodes.label: docker_host table
nodes.detail: Holds the Docker hosts (daemon / type / name)

nodes.label: monitor table
nodes.detail: Holds the monitored targets' settings (including foreign keys such as proxy_id)

nodes.label: heartbeat table
nodes.detail: Holds each monitor's check results (status / msg / important / time and more)

nodes.label: remote_browser table
nodes.detail: Holds the remote browser endpoints (name / url / user_id)

nodes.label: stat_minutely table
nodes.detail: Holds the per-minute aggregates for each monitor

nodes.label: stat_daily table
nodes.detail: Holds the per-day aggregates for each monitor

nodes.label: stat_hourly table
nodes.detail: Holds the per-hour aggregates for each monitor

nodes.label: SQLite file
nodes.detail: The actual kuma.db file (Database.sqlitePath). What the size check and the VACUUM act on

nodes.label: Query the Docker daemon
nodes.detail: Calls the Docker daemon API's /containers/json?all=true over a socket or TCP

flows.title: Save the settings

steps.label: Call saveSettings() through the computed property
Once validation passes, get the socket and prepare the emit
socket.on("setSettings") is registered inside the connection
Re-verify the current password
steps.branch: only when disableAuth changes from false to true

steps.label: JSON-encode each key of the matching type and R.store it
The success callback runs loadSettings() again
socket.on("getSettings") is registered inside the connection

notes: The password re-check (doubleCheckPassword) only runs when disableAuth changes from false to true (server/server.js:1508-1511). Save on the General screen never touches disableAuth, so that branch normally does not fire

When authentication is being enabled (disableAuth true to false), every client is force-logged-out as a fix for GHSA-23q2-5gf8-gjpp (server/server.js:1515-1517; not drawn on the main path of this flow)
General.vue's saveGeneral() calls this.saveSettings() without a currentPassword, so from this UI it is sent as undefined

flows.title: Add a proxy
flows.trigger: Opening the Setup Proxy dialog on Settings > Proxies and clicking Save

steps.label: socket.on("addProxy") is registered inside the connection
If it is the default, clear the old default, then set the bean values and R.store
Apply to every monitor right after saving
UPDATE proxy_id on every monitor of that user
Re-apply to the monitors after the save answers
Refetch id and proxy_id and apply them to monitorList (no write)

notes: With applyExisting=true the work runs twice — inside Proxy.save (server/proxy.js:57-59) and in the socket handler (server/socket-handlers/proxy-socket-handler.js:20-23). Only applyProxyEveryMonitor inside save writes to the DB; reloadProxy just re-syncs memory

flows.title: Add and test a Docker host
flows.trigger: Opening the Setup Docker Host dialog on Settings > Docker Hosts and clicking Test or Save

steps.label: socket.on("testDockerHost") is registered inside the connection
socket.on("addDockerHost") is registered inside the connection
Set the bean values and save with R.store

notes: Test and Save are separate buttons in the dialog with nothing in the code linking them. Which one you press first is up to you (all of server/socket-handlers/docker-socket-handler.js was checked; nothing forces an order)
testDockerHost is a read-only connectivity check that changes nothing in the DB

flows.title: Add a remote browser
flows.trigger: Opening the Add a Remote Browser dialog on Settings > Remote Browsers and clicking Save

steps.label: socket.on("addRemoteBrowser") is registered inside the connection
Set the bean values and save with R.store

flows.title: Check the DB size and shrink it
flows.trigger: The DB size is fetched automatically when Settings > Monitor History opens, and the Shrink Database button compacts it

steps.label: Prepare to emit getDatabaseSize on mount
socket.on("getDatabaseSize") is registered inside the connection
Read the file size with fs.stat (SQLite only)
The Shrink Database button prepares the emit
socket.on("shrinkDatabase") is registered inside the connection
Fetch the size again after a successful shrink

notes: Outside SQLite (MariaDB / embedded-mariadb) getSize returns 0 and shrink does nothing (server/database.js:812-820,826-830)

flows.title: Clear the event history
flows.trigger: Choosing Clear Data > Events on the monitor details screen and answering Yes

steps.label: socket.on("clearEvents") is registered inside the connection
UPDATE heartbeat SET msg='',important=0 WHERE monitor_id=?

notes: There is no dedicated service function; the socket.on handler runs R.exec directly (server/server.js:1664)
No row is deleted — only msg and important are cleared (it drops out of the important events view while the heartbeat itself stays)
No password re-check (only checkLogin; the UI asks nothing beyond Yes/No in the Confirm dialog)

flows.title: Clear the heartbeats
flows.trigger: Choosing Clear Data > Heartbeats on the monitor details screen and answering Yes

steps.label: socket.on("clearHeartbeats") is registered inside the connection
Restart the monitor to reset the statistics
steps.branch: only when that monitor is active

notes: The API event is named "clearHeartbeats", yet it deletes stat_minutely/hourly/daily along with the heartbeats — in effect wiping that monitor's statistics entirely (server/server.js:1683, server/uptime-calculator.js:852-860)

flows.title: Clear the statistics
flows.trigger: The Clear all statistics button on Settings > Monitor History, then Yes in the confirm dialog

steps.label: socket.on("clearStatistics") is registered inside the connection
DELETE FROM heartbeat (everything, no WHERE clause)
Restart every monitor to reset the statistics

notes: It deletes for every monitor at once (no WHERE clause, server/uptime-calculator.js:866-873)
On success the UI reloads the whole page with this.$router.go() (src/components/settings/MonitorHistory.vue:137)
